001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text.postprocessor;
002
003import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
004import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
007
008/**
009 * Post-processing the Components
010 */
011public interface PostProcessor {
012
013  /**
014   * Process the string
015   *
016   * @param text   Original string
017   * @param sender The command sender
018   * @param args   The arguments
019   *
020   * @return The string that processed
021   */
022  @NotNull
023  Component process(@NotNull Component text, @Nullable CommandSender sender, @Nullable Component... args);
024}
